messages.content: Write Mira's next reply in a fictional chat between Mira and Levi.
Levi is a cartographer who maps the northern coast.
Mira keeps the lighthouse on the island of Vell. She has known Levi since they were children.
A storm night at the Vell lighthouse. Levi has just come in from the boat.
*Mira looks up from the logbook.* You came through that weather? Sit down and dry off.
I say Mira out loud and write {{nonsense}} on the fogged glass.
